lines: Main is `cd64e5b8`, pushed 22:40 UTC. In it since the last status: the tree's fifth pass so far (`f2bec6e0`, the crown as unlike rounded masses, merged as `fadebca9`) and the tree made again (leaves 20164 triangles in 3367 tufts, 668 lumps on 26 clumps). On that tree: `npx tsc --noEmit` clean, the build green, the whole test run 58 files passed and 1 skipped, 794 tests passed and 4 skipped; the gate's detail line for summer still red by the base alone: "FAIL M3 summer-rest: 0.6211" with base 0.621 and miniature 0.816 (0.820 before). Picture 1 is summer at rest on it.

A second slip of mine of the same kind: the merge `fadebca9` reached origin at 22:30 UTC through the routine push of the log, before its checks were read and before the tree was made again, so for ten minutes main held the tree's new code beside the old asset. The checks then read green and the asset followed. The push helper now refuses to push while a merge waits for its checks.

Fall and spring are worked on now, beside summer (decision 170). Their loops closed at the round limit below the bar in phase 5 and their detail lines are red on main: "FAIL M3 fall-rest: 0.5336" (miniature 0.534, base 0.700) and "FAIL M3 spring-rest: 0.4308" (base 0.431). Pictures 2 and 3 show why, each with the approved picture left: fall's cottage has large light stones, a flat roof and a tree behind several hundred golden dots; spring's base is a smooth velvet band of moss over large smooth stones with a broad white band of water. `/root/fall_scene_builder` started 22:23 UTC (`tools/briefs/p6/fall-scene.md`); its first look: the golden dots are the air's embers, not the tree's (the tree holds 26), and the detail is lost in the lower half of the miniature (ground, fence, water, the wall's foot). Spring's base has its job file (`tools/briefs/p6/spring-base.md`) and starts when a place is free; so does fall's air.

Winter at 3840 in motion has its mender since 22:12 UTC (`tools/briefs/p6/winter-glints.md`, picture 4: the lamp's reflection on the pond in three neighbouring frames at 5 times). Its first word: the dots come from the ice's bump normal feeding a lamp lobe of 2.6 degrees where the ice's map stands at 4 or more texels a pixel; with that normal held flat every dot is gone. The frost frond that snaps is the lens blur taking the frost for what stands behind it; that mend sits in shared code and comes to /root as lines.

Decided: the inertia's move of summer's miniature number is taken (decision 169: with the particles hidden the miniature is byte for byte the same; fewer seed heads snag on it). Open item 245 is closed (cover of summer into fall 0.9602 on main by a farm machine). Open item 248 is new: the strict run through the app's own path at high fails on winter-shake, on main too (754 pixels, largest step 11); the strict checker has it.

The hand's last pass is in: twist up to 10 degrees after each turn, a deeper arched dip, uneven strokes with a heavy start, all eight cover lines green on its head. It is merged here as `f2af729e` and its checks run; the inertia follows it.

Measured for the film on summer's glass (median of a box, approved against build): upper middle 98, 86, 74 against 172, 149, 111; right of the tree 119, 103, 82 against 166, 159, 142; left of the tree the two agree. The glass's builder has the numbers.
Being drawn at 3840 final on the farm: summer's second with the most travel, and 60 frames of the change from winter into spring (2464 samples, up to 90 a frame in the swap; about two hours).
Sound: 7,420 of 10,000 credits, unchanged, no call planned.
phase 6: 19.86 h used of its 12.00 h box
allowance (after the review): 19.86 h used of 12.00 h allowed

pictures.caption: Summer at rest on main cd64e5b8, hd, review tier, with the tree's fifth pass so far: the crown in separate rounded masses. Still below the bar: a pale film over the upper middle and right of the glass, a dark crown without lit rims, seed heads too large and too white, the base.
Fall's miniature at two times, the approved picture left and the build right. Below the bar: large light stones, a flat roof, a tree behind several hundred golden dots.
Spring's base at two times, the approved picture left and the build right. Below the bar: smooth velvet moss, large smooth stones, a broad white band of water, few thick roots.
Winter at 3840 final in motion: the lamp's reflection on the pond ice in three neighbouring frames at 5 times. The dots are other dots in every frame. A mender has it.
